harness: Claude Code Agent tool (general-purpose subagent), one bounded task, read-only inputs, one permitted output path

model.note: the configured model id for the session that spawned the run; the serving model is not independently attested

transcript.kind: final report verbatim; per-call tool log not captured

verification.rerun_by: the demo re-executes the check over this output on every run (the pass is not replayed, the output is)

boundary: A recorded bounded run: the transcript and output are kept and digest-bound; it is not a live agent execution during the demo, and the model identity is declared, not attested.
